title: Drink like the devil till it turns adelite.
html_source: Adelite is a rare mineral, often grayish in color. Bloom seems to be thinking that Paddy Dignam’s nose would eventually turn gray from drinking, meaning he would die from it. There has been some debate about Joyce’s usage of the word.
